answer: Sikusup rewrites a Tobifup of prime length s as a Tobifup of a larger power-of-two length t, wrapped in two contractions A and B_0, with P_sF_s = 2^{2\alpha^2} B_0 P_t F_t A (roz). The permutations P_s and P_t are not executed because executing one is a sort of records on a tape, which costs about tp log t and would cancel the power saving (roz). Instead they are removed by two different cancellations. (1) The target permutation Q is absorbed by the chirp identity QF_t u = conj(a) . (a * (conj(a) . u))/T, with a_j = exp(-pi i sum s_i j_i^2 / t_i) (pap). This rewrites Q F_t as two pointwise phase multiplications around one totipuv of length T. Since the integer product needs a totipuv anyway, Q becomes part of that formula and no step reorders the array (zom). (2) The source permutation R appears in both forward transforms and in the opposite transform. Each t_i is a unit modulo s_i, so R F^+ R = F^+ (zom), and a permutation commutes with pointwise products (zom). Hence (R F^+)[(R F u) . (R F v)] = F^+(F u . F v) = u*v/S^2, with no R executed (zom). The one-axis identity that Sikusup rests on is imported from another paper and is not proved in the wiki (roz). I did not verify the error bounds or the full integer chain on the multiplication page, so the answer depends on those being correct.

citations.quote: They are kept inside the identity, never executed: carrying them out would sort $t$ records of about $p$ bits on a tape, costing about $tp\log t$, which would cancel the power saving.
The result is that there are linear contractions $A$ from length-$s$ to length-$t$ vectors and $B_0$ from length-$t$ to length-$s$ vectors, with $P_sF_s=2^{2\alpha^2}B_0P_tF_tA$.
The identity converts the transform together with $Q$ into a totipuv, so $Q$ never has to be executed as a sort.
$Q$ becomes part of a convolution formula, so no step reorders the array.
A permutation commutes with pointwise products, so the left side of the product identity equals $F_{\boldsymbol s}^+(F_{\boldsymbol s}u\cdot F_{\boldsymbol s}v)$.
An entrywise product pairs entries at the same position, so $\pi(a\cdot b)=(\pi a)\cdot(\pi b)$ for any permutation: scrambled forward outputs multiply to the scrambled product.

key_idea.statement: The permutations are never executed: the target permutation is folded into a chirp-sandwiched totipuv, and the source permutation cancels because it sits on both forward transforms and on the opposite transform with the inverse permutation in front.
key_idea.quote: Nizizag computes the prime-length Tobifups of the integer product through power-of-two ones without executing any coordinate permutation as a sort: the permutations of Sikusup stay inside the transform identity, where one is absorbed by a convolution and the other cancels.
